description: Defines the CKEDITOR.event class, which provides an internal event handling system for CKEditor objects, including methods for registering, firing, and managing event listeners.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.event
classes.description: A base class for objects requiring event handling features, providing methods to register, fire, and manage event listeners.

methods.name: implementOn
methods.description: Implements event handling features into a target object by copying methods from CKEDITOR.event.prototype.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a listener function for a specific event, with optional scope, data, and priority.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires an event, calling all registered listeners with provided data and context, supporting stop and cancel mechanisms.

methods.name: fireOnce
methods.description: Fires an event and then removes all listeners for that event, ensuring they are called only once.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Unregisters a specific listener function from an event.

methods.name: hasListeners
methods.description: Checks if there are any listeners registered for a specific event.
